notes:
Level editor in the game

A hundred new levels are faster to make by building them than by writing
JSON. The editor gets an author mode: the board is the model solution and
its fixed parts are what the level gives (G toggles, orange corners), a
form holds texts in both languages, hints, allowed parts and the test,
with buttons that derive a formula test from the given switches and
lamps and the allowed parts and par from the solution. Check runs the
test without touching progress; Save writes the level into its chapter
file and the solution next to the others. Offered in the main menu when
run from the source tree; the packed game gets it with player levels.

Levels with a formula test show a truth table made from it again. The
trace layer cache keyed boards by the id of their geometry, which Python
hands out again after a free - it now holds the object itself.
